tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 4 (accounts & currency) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA. The repo is an existing, committed Vite + React 19 + TS project at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 4) and spec.md (Currency & Account Support) first. This is the FIRST real feature on top of the finished spine (crypto, encrypted data layer + repositories, Zustand stores with initializeStores, auth vault, protected router shell). Reuse them; do not reimplement. EXISTING SEAMS: src/lib/db/ (MonetaFoxDB, Repositories, models incl. Account/Transaction/Settings, AccountType union), src/stores/ (useAccountStore, useSettingsStore, etc., each with initialize(repos) + CRUD), src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx (a stub

Accounts

to replace), src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (already has a delete-account danger zone — ADD to it, don't remove that). FIXED CONVENTIONS (follow exactly — a hidden contract test pins them): - transaction.amount is SIGNED: positive = inflow, negative = outflow. - account balance = openingBalance + Σ (signed amounts of that account's transactions), in the account's OWN currency. - FX rates map: rates[currency] = number of BASE-currency units per 1 unit of `currency`. Converting the base currency to itself is the identity. A missing rate must THROW, not guess. - Single base currency, fixed at setup: store it on the Settings record; once set it is not changed casually (Phase 4 may allow changing it only while there are no accounts/transactions). BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/currency/** (create), src/lib/accounts/** (create), src/lib/db/models.ts (ADD fields only — e.g. Account.openingBalance?: number, Settings.rates?: Record; do NOT change database.ts or repository.ts), src/stores/accountStore.ts and src/stores/settingsStore.ts (extend with the actions this phase needs), src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx and src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx, and new src/components/** files for account/currency UI (do NOT modify existing components). package.json only if you genuinely need a dep (prefer none). Do NOT modify src/lib/crypto/**, src/lib/auth/**, src/lib/db/database.ts or repository.ts, other stores, src/routes.tsx/RequireAuth, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT git commit or push. DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (pinned by the hidden contract test; drift fails it): 1. src/lib/currency/index.ts: - a reasonable CURRENCIES list (major ISO fiat + BTC/ETH), each with code + symbol + name. - export function convertToBase(amount: number, from: string, base: string, rates: Record): number — identity when from===base; else amount * rates[from]; THROW if the rate is missing. - a formatCurrency(amount, code) helper for display. 2. src/lib/accounts/index.ts: - export function accountBalance(account: Account, transactions: Transaction[]): number — openingBalance + Σ signed amounts where tx.accountId === account.id, in the account currency. - export function netWorthInBase(accounts: Account[], transactions: Transaction[], base: string, rates: Record): number — Σ over accounts of convertToBase(accountBalance(acc, txns), acc.currency, base, rates). Exclude archived accounts. 3. src/lib/db/models.ts — add Account.openingBalance?: number and Settings.rates?: Record (leave everything else intact). 4. src/stores/settingsStore.ts — ensure a Settings record exists (baseCurrency + rates); actions to set the base currency (guarded per the rule above) and to set/update an FX rate. 5. src/stores/accountStore.ts — ensure real add/update/archive/remove actions delegating to the encrypted repository (extend if the 3a version is thin). 6. src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx — a real accounts view: list accounts showing per-account balance (in its own currency) AND the base-converted value, plus a total net worth in base currency; a create form/wizard (type from the AccountType union, name, currency, openingBalance); edit; archive/unarchive; delete with confirm. Use the existing ui/button, ui/card, and cn() util. If no base currency is set yet (first run), prompt the user to choose one before adding accounts. 7. src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx — add a Currency section: show/choose the base currency (locked once accounts exist) and manage manual FX rates (currency → rate). Keep the existing delete-account danger zone. HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root): `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all must exit 0. Write real Vitest tests for the currency + accounts functions and the store actions. OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the balance/FX design and sign convention, how base currency is fixed at setup, and any Phase 5 (transactions) follow-up. HARD RULES: match the API signatures and conventions exactly (signed amounts, rate = base-per-unit, missing rate throws); store amounts in the ORIGINAL currency and convert only for reporting; reuse the crypto/db/store/auth layers; keep it typed and boring; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (convertToBase identity/foreign/crypto/missing-rate-throws; accountBalance = opening + signed sums for the right account; netWorthInBase aggregates converted balances). The currency + accounts modules exist with the exact API; AccountsPage has real create/edit/archive CRUD wired to the store and shows per-account + base-converted balances; base-currency + FX-rate management is surfaced; the Account model has openingBalance. The Phase 3a/2/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build all exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
